URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/20/what-we-know-about-us-soldiers-killed-in-iran-war-and-iranian-casualties
NOTE: Al Jazeera (20 Jul). US military death toll rose to 17 since war began, at least 420 wounded, at least one missing. Ninth night concluded Sunday. Iran hit US transport planes at Aqaba airport, Jordan. Two named US dead: 1st Lt Tyler James Feehan, 25 (killed Sat) and Pvt Isabella Gonzales, 19 (died Fri) at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base, Jordan. Iran Health Ministry (18 Jul): at least 50 killed, 500+ injured in US July strikes. Feb-June (pre-MoU): at least 3,468 killed in US-Israeli attacks, 26,500+ injured.
